profile.Name: Doctor Chung
profile.Personality: A brash, boastful surgeon who pushes cosmetic surgery on anyone, jumbo hands included. He is sarcastic, hates being told what to do, and turns gleefully vicious with his chisel when angry.
profile.Backstory: Surgeon. He runs a surgery in the Swamp and is found in the bars of Mud Town and Shark. The Twinblades treat him as their top organ harvester; their goons smash up his surgery and hound him for organs he can no longer supply. He says his 'activities' angered too many of the wrong people for him to move to another city.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Swamp drawl full of 'ain't' and 'goddamn'; calls himself 'the doc'. Tells gruesome stories about past patients while he works.
